name: hf-20261121-15
hook: Heavy suitcase in Seoul? Watch this

items.en: Checked out but flying late? Ask the front desk to keep your bags
items.ja: チェックアウト後もフロントで荷物預かり
items.zh: 退房后也可以请前台寄存行李

items.en: Many subway stations have lockers — look for this sign
items.ja: 多くの地下鉄駅にコインロッカーあり
items.zh: 很多地铁站都有储物柜

items.en: Taxi with a suitcase? Say: please open the trunk
items.ja: タクシーで「トランク開けてください」
items.zh: 打车时说：请打开后备箱

cta_en:
Which tip helps you most?
1, 2 or 3
cta2_en: Save this for your Seoul trip
